text:
zoe: Heads-up - Reseller GovCloud sent a Q4 rebate notice this morning (ref GCP-472) for $92,400 tied to a volume threshold they exceeded. They want the credit applied against our Q4 invoice run. Need guidance on revenue recognition and whether this requires a prior-period adjustment. Doc attached.
matt: Is the rebate structurally a reduction of consideration (i.e., contra-revenue) or a separate liability (rebate accrual payable to reseller)? Contract clause says rebates reduce net revenue if earned by reseller.
rene: Quick contract check: Section 6.3 indicates a retrospective volume rebate based on shipped ARR tiers; if met, we owe a credit to reseller and should reduce recognized revenue for the periods where the underlying sales were recorded.
emma: How material is $92.4k relative to revenue? FP&A materiality threshold for prior-period restatement is $100k. Under threshold but still requires disclosure in close pack if restated.
zoe: For month-end close, my proposal: book an adjusting entry to reduce recognized revenue for Q4 (split across Oct-Nov-Dec by original revenue schedule), and record a payable to reseller. If reseller wants immediate cash credit, we may also need to reclass cash/credit memo when paid.
matt: Agreed. We should update the revenue schedules and update deferred revenue rollforwards. Since amount < $100k, we can do a current-period adjustment in the Q1 close with clear notes; no external restatement needed per policy but include in audit trail.
fpna-bot: FP&A sign-off required for revenue adjustments affecting prior closed periods. @emma please confirm approval for a retrospective allocation within current quarter close.
emma: Approving adjustment process under $100k. Please ensure allocation uses original revenue recognition dates. Approved pending allocation calc.
rene: I'll run the revenue schedule extraction for the affected customer IDs and map which invoices recognize into Q4 buckets. Expect CSV in /reports/revenue/rebate-GCP-472.csv in 30m. Allocation method: revenue-weighted by invoice recognition dates.
zoe: Draft JE to record in Q1 close pack (posting to reflect reduction in prior period but booked in current period with memo):

``
Date: 2026-04-01
Dr: Revenue - Hosted Services (contra)        92,400
Cr: Accrued Reseller Credits Payable         92,400
Memo: GovCloud GCP-472 Q4 volume rebate; allocation to Oct/Nov/Dec revenue schedules pending.
``

matt: Also update deferred revenue rollforward and include a line item showing the rebate allocation reducing recognized revenue for each month. Prepare reversal/footnote entries for audit.
fpna-bot: Please attach supporting schedule and contract excerpt to this thread for audit.
zoe: Attached contract excerpt and will upload schedule once Rene posts. Action items: @rene produce allocation CSV; @matt update revenue schedules and close commentary; @emma sign final JE after schedule review. Tagging monthend/close and revenue-rec team.
it-billing-bot: Document saved to /invoices/resellers/govcloud/GCP-472.pdf
zoe: Target - post provisional JE and supporting schedule in close pack by EOD. Will update thread with allocation. Thanks.
